runs.answer: Inflation means prices go up over time. Money gets a little less powerful, so you need more of it to buy the same things. Why? Lots of people want to buy things, and businesses charge more because costs for things like food, gas, and wages keep rising. So a toy that cost $10 might cost $12 later.

Inflation means prices slowly go up over time. Think of it like this: when lots of people have more money to spend, stores can charge more because people still want to buy things.
